haiku-low.q1: It still lands in the same account. Matching is by Google sub only, email is not checked for a linked sub, and users.email is never changed by Google.
haiku-low.q2: The user must submit the correct password on Confirm your password (POST /auth/google/confirm) before the link is inserted and the session starts.
haiku-low.q3: Each wrong password adds to failed_logins. The 5th locks the account for 15 minutes, deletes the pending link and clears the cookie. The user must restart Google sign-in.
haiku-low.q4: No match: a new users row with NULL password_hash and verified email is created, the Google identity is linked, and a session starts. Unverified: redirect to /login asking for email and password.
haiku-low.q5: Both fail with the error page: sign-in expired or invalid, try again. The attempt record expires after 10 minutes, and GETDEL removes it on first use.
haiku-low.q6: A new sessions row and a new sid cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, 14 days). Any sessions row for the browser's old sid is deleted first.
haiku-low.q7: No password or email match is required, only that the session user equals the attempt user_id. If the Google account is linked elsewhere, Settings shows it is linked to another account.
haiku-low.q8: In Redis key oidc:attempt:STATE, TTL 10 minutes. The callback removes it with an atomic GETDEL as its first step, so it is single use.
haiku-low.q9: In Redis oidc:pending:ID with user_id, google_sub, google_email and next. The browser holds only the random ID in a pending_link cookie. Link success or account lock deletes it, or it expires.
haiku-low.q10: In the PostgreSQL user_identities table. UNIQUE(provider, subject) allows one user per Google account, and UNIQUE(user_id, provider) allows one Google account per user.
haiku-low.q11: The user is redirected to /login with Google sign-in failed, try again. The exchange is not retried; the user must start again from the button.
haiku-low.q12: The attempt record's mode field (login or link) decides. Link mode requires the session user to equal the attempt's user_id, otherwise the sign-in-expired error page is shown.

sonnet.q1: They land in the same account. Matching is by sub only; email is checked only when the sub is not linked, so the changed Gmail address does not matter. Google never changes users.email.
sonnet.q2: The pending record oidc:pending:ID is written to Redis (TTL 10 min) and the pending_link cookie is set. The user must confirm the account's password on POST /auth/google/confirm. The pending record must still exist and the account must not be locked. The bcrypt check must pass. Then user_identities is inserted and start_session runs.
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins, and the form is shown again. On the 5th wrong password the account is locked for 15 minutes (locked_until = now + 15 min) and the counter resets. The pending record is deleted and the cookie cleared. 'Account temporarily locked' is shown. No link is created. The user must start Google sign-in again after the lock.
sonnet.q4: If the email is verified and matches no user, one transaction inserts a new users row (password_hash NULL, email_verified_at now) and a user_identities row. Then a session starts. If email_verified is false, the user is redirected to /login with 'use email and password'. Nothing is written.
sonnet.q5: The error page 'sign-in expired or invalid, try again'. The oidc:attempt record has expired (10 min TTL) or has already been used (GETDEL), so the record is not found. Nothing is written.
sonnet.q6: A new sessions row is inserted and the sid cookie is set (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, 14 days, slid forward on use). The sessions row for any sid the browser already had is deleted first. Then the user is redirected to next if it is a relative path on the site, otherwise to /home.
sonnet.q7: No password is asked and the emails may differ. The session user must equal the attempt's user_id; otherwise it goes to the error page. If the sub is already in user_identities for another user, Settings shows 'this Google account is linked to another account' and nothing is inserted. If it is already linked to this user, Settings shows 'already linked'.
sonnet.q8: They are kept in Redis under oidc:attempt:<state> (TTL 10 min), which holds mode, user_id (link only), nonce, the PKCE code_verifier and next. The callback deletes it with an atomic GETDEL as its first step. If it is never used, it expires.
sonnet.q9: It is held in Redis under oidc:pending:<id> (TTL 10 min), holding user_id, google_sub, google_email and next. The browser holds only the random id, in an HttpOnly, Secure pending_link cookie. The record is deleted when the link succeeds or the account locks, and otherwise it expires.
sonnet.q10: In the PostgreSQL table user_identities (user_id, provider='google', subject = Google sub, email_at_link, linked_at). UNIQUE(provider, subject) gives one user per Google account. UNIQUE(user_id, provider) gives one Google account per user.
sonnet.q11: The user is redirected to /login with 'Google sign-in failed, try again'. The exchange is not retried, because the code is single-use and the attempt record is already gone. The user starts again from the button. Nothing is written.
sonnet.q12: The mode (login or link) is stored in the oidc:attempt record, which the callback reads via GETDEL. For link mode the record also holds user_id. The callback checks that the current session user equals the attempt's user_id. If not, it shows the error page and links nothing.
